crossRefs.note: “Teach me, and I will hold my peace. Cause me to understand my error.
How forcible are words of uprightness! But your reproof, what does it reprove?
“Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers.
“Shouldn’t the multitude of words be answered? Should a man full of talk be justified?
that he would show you the secrets of wisdom! For true wisdom has two sides. Know therefore that God exacts of you less…
An empty-headed man becomes wise when a man is born as a wild donkey’s colt.
“Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge, and fill himself with the east wind?
For you have hidden their heart from understanding, Therefore you will not exalt them.
I have heard the reproof which puts me to shame. The spirit of my understanding answers me.
I said, ‘Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.’
The rich man is wise in his own eyes; but the poor who has understanding sees through him.
Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!
We are fools for Christ’s sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You have honor, but we…
I say this to move you to shame. Isn’t there even one wise man among you who would be able to decide between his…

translations.web: “No doubt, but you are the people, and wisdom will die with you.
translations.bsb: “Truly then you are the people with whom wisdom itself will die!
translations.kjv: No doubt but ye are the people, and wisdom shall die
translations.asv: No doubt but ye are the people, And wisdom shall die with you.
